newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek bonds idle, await auction result, forwards up.
newsitem.headline: Greek bonds idle, await auction result, forwards up.

text.p: Greek depos were steady and implied three- to one-year drachma rates from forex forwards rose before bond auction results, dealers said.
Bonds prices were little changed amid low volume, traders said.

Greece seeks bids for a further 75 billion drachmas each of five- and seven-year bonds with coupons of 9.2 percent and 8.9 percent, respectively, and 120 billion drachmas ($429.2 million) of 8.8 percent, 10-year bonds.
The five- and seven-year bonds were auctioned for the first time ever on March 19 and then, bids were re-opened on June 17. The 10-year bonds were auctioned for the first time ever on June 17.
Greece will also auction 150 billion drachmas of seven-year floating rate notes on July 29.
Ecu/drachma traded narrowly around 309.55 and mark/drachma was softer at 156.60/65 from an earlier 156.80/85 on a firmer ecu/mark, forex dealers said.
The mark was quoted at 156.64/69 from Tuesday's 156.700 fix, the dollar at 281.36/46 drachmas from 281.020 and the ecu at 309.49/59 from 309.55 drachmas.
